goal: Allow users to manually rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions via RPC or GUI
Avoids needing to manually look up raw transaction hex to invoke sendrawtransaction
agreement: Broad concept support for adding manual rebroadcast capability (mzumsande, murchandamus, rkrux, polespinasa)
Unaddressed objection: rebroadcast fails with empty error if feerate exceeds -maxfeerate (fametrano)
Approach ACK with open nits on redundant wallet locking and depth caching (pseudoramdom)
Code approval with minor locking suggestion still open (vasild)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it provides a direct RPC and GUI interface to rebroadcast transactions dropped from mempools
saves users from having to manually extract raw hex and call sendrawtransaction
